starter.hint: Build a deck from your own entities. Replace swaps out the current tabs; Add keeps them.
starter.none: Nothing to build: no matching entities found for "{name}".
starter.kind.lights: Lights: a tab per area with lights
starter.kind.media: Media: a tab per media player
starter.kind.family: Family: a tab per person, with a map
convert.hint: Paste the YAML of a tabbed-card, swipe-card, state-switch, a vertical/horizontal stack or grid, Bubble Card pop-ups (in stacks or on their own), Mushroom chips used as navigation, a conditional card, a sections view or a whole dashboard.
convert.error.empty: There's nothing to convert in that list.
convert.error.not_card: That doesn't look like a card, a list of cards, a view or a dashboard.
convert.error.no_tabs: Nothing to convert: no cards found.
convert.source.sections: a sections view (one tab per section)
convert.source.stack: a stack (one tab per card or heading)
convert.note.styles: Only --mdc-theme-primary was carried over (as --tabdeck-accent); other tabbed-card styles have no Tabdeck equivalent.
convert.note.tab_styles: Per-tab styles from tabbed-card were not carried over.
convert.note.state_switch_mode: This state-switch mode (user / media query / template) has no direct equivalent; the states became plain tabs. Add visibility conditions if needed.
convert.note.bubble: Each pop-up became a tab; the pop-up's own button and styling are not used.
convert.note.dashboard: Each view became a tab. Large dashboards can make a heavy card; consider lazy: true.
editor.global.dock: Dock at the bottom of the screen
editor.global.content_arrows: Previous / next arrows over the content
editor.global.history: Back button returns to the previous tab
editor.global.customize: Let people reorder and hide tabs
editor.tab.area: Area (no card: shows its entities as tiles)
editor.global.alert_first: Move alerting tabs to the front
editor.tab.picture: Picture instead of the icon (URL or entity, e.g. person.alex)
editor.contrast_low: {field} has low contrast with this theme's card background ({ratio}:1), so it may be hard to read.
editor.global.bar_autohide: Hide the pinned bar while scrolling down
editor.global.hold_peek: Hold a tab to preview it
editor.global.changed_dot: Dot on tabs that changed since you last looked
editor.global.health_dim: Fade tabs whose devices are unavailable
editor.tab.pip: Keep in a floating window after switching away
editor.opt.preload.all: All tabs, one at a time
export.hint: A sections view with one section per tab. Copy it, then in a dashboard choose Edit → ⋮ → Raw configuration editor and paste it as a new entry under views:.
export.skipped: Left out (action tabs with no card): {names}.
export.note.templates: Tab names that are templates become "Tab 1", "Tab 2"…: section headings can't use templates.
export.note.conditions: Template and time conditions were kept, but sections only understand state, numeric state, screen and user conditions.
export.note.groups: Grouped tabs export as a nested Tabdeck card inside their section.
export.note.auto_tabs: Generated tabs (auto_tabs) aren't included: only the tabs written in the config are.
editor.global.popup: Open tabs in a popup from other cards
editor.opt.popup.hidden: On, and hide the deck itself
editor.global.wheel_switch: Mouse wheel over the tab bar changes tab (desktop)
editor.global.drag_reorder: Drag tabs on the bar to reorder
editor.tab.empty_message: Message when every card is hidden
editor.global.loading_placeholder: Grey boxes while a tab's cards load
editor.global.scroll_memory: Each tab remembers how far down you scrolled
editor.global.bar_limit: Most tabs shown in the bar
editor.tab.ring_style: Show the ring as a bar under the tab
editor.global.badge_bounce: Badges bounce when their value changes
editor.global.hidden_alerts: ⋯ menu counts alerts on tabs that don't fit
editor.global.summary_chip: Alert count chip at the end of the bar
editor.global.picture_accent: Accent colour from each tab's picture
editor.global.learned_default: Learn the usual tab per time of day
editor.tab.keep_awake: Keep the screen on while this tab is open (https only)
editor.preview_hint: click a tab to edit it
lint.title: one:Config check · {n} note|other:Config check · {n} notes
lint.dock_wizard: dock and wizard clash: the wizard wins, so the bar isn't docked.
lint.dock_hide_bar: dock does nothing with hide_bar: there's no bar to dock.
lint.remember_entity: remember: entity needs remember_entity (an input_text or input_number).
lint.default_tab: default_tab "{value}" doesn't match any tab, so the deck opens on the first one.
lint.needs_tab: {key} does nothing: no tab has {other} conditions.
lint.unknown: Unknown option {key}: a typo? The visual editor drops it when you save.
lint.unknown_tab: Tab "{tab}": unknown option {key}: a typo? The visual editor drops it when you save.
lint.many_tabs: {count} tabs: turn on lazy so the card loads faster.
lint.preload_all: preload: all builds all {count} tabs anyway; preload: idle is lighter.
lint.fast_refresh: Tab "{tab}": auto_refresh under a minute rebuilds its card very often.
lint.templates: {count} templates in tab fields: each one is a live subscription to Home Assistant.
editor.bulk.hint: Tick tabs in the list, fill in what to change and apply. Empty fields stay as they are.
rooms.hint: One tab per room (Home Assistant area), listing its entities. Tick the rooms you want; the tabs are added after the current ones.
rooms.none: No rooms found. Add areas in Settings → Areas, labels & zones and assign devices to them.
summary.title: What this card does
summary.tabs: one:This deck has {n} tab: {names}.|other:This deck has {n} tabs: {names}.
summary.auto_source: It adds tabs by itself from {source}.
summary.auto_template: It adds tabs by itself from a template.
summary.default_if: one:It opens on {names} instead when its conditions are met.|other:It opens on {names} instead when their conditions are met.
summary.remember_browser: Each browser comes back to the tab it had open last.
summary.remember_url: The open tab is kept in the page address, so links and reloads keep it.
summary.remember_entity: The open tab is stored in {entity}, so every device shows the same one.
summary.visibility: one:{names} only shows up some of the time.|other:{names} only show up some of the time.
summary.alerts: one:{names} pulses when it needs attention.|other:{names} pulse when they need attention.
summary.badges: one:{names} shows a badge.|other:{names} show a badge.
summary.pin: one:{names} needs a PIN.|other:{names} need a PIN.
summary.actions: one:{names} runs an action instead of opening.|other:{names} run an action instead of opening.
summary.swipe: Swipe left or right to move between tabs.
summary.swipe_mouse: Swipe, or drag with the mouse, to move between tabs.
summary.rotate: one:It moves to the next tab every {n} second.|other:It moves to the next tab every {n} seconds.
summary.idle_return: one:After {n} second without a touch it goes back to {tab}.|other:After {n} seconds without a touch it goes back to {tab}.
summary.remote_event: Automations can switch the tab with a tabdeck_select event.
summary.follow_room: It shows the tab for the room {entity} says you're in.
summary.takeover: one:When {entity} triggers, it shows {tab} for {n} second, then goes back.|other:When {entity} triggers, it shows {tab} for {n} seconds, then goes back.
summary.quiet_time: Between {from} and {to} it switches nothing by itself.
summary.quiet_entity: While {entity} is on, it switches nothing by itself.
summary.lazy: Tabs load the first time they're opened.
convert.note.chips: Each chip that opens a view became a tab showing that view (view:); a chip that opens a web address became an action tab. Other chips were left out.
convert.note.bubble_nav: Names and icons missing on pop-ups were taken from the buttons or chips that open them.
convert.note.bubble_outside: Cards outside the pop-ups were left out (navigation buttons and chips aren't needed with tabs).
whatsnew.title: New in Tabdeck {version}
whatsnew.1_5_0: Home Assistant's colour names and colour picker, text that stays readable on solid colours, six new presets, and tabs with photos, animated icons and their own font.
whatsnew.1_6_0: The editor can undo and redo, opens a tab's settings when you click it in the preview, checks your config, explains it in plain words, edits several tabs at once, suggests icons and makes tabs from your rooms.
editor.opt.debug.speed: Panel + draw time on each tab
editor.global.offline_banner: Warn when the connection to Home Assistant is lost
instant.title: Rooms
instant.error.failed: Couldn't create the dashboard. Nothing was changed.

style_import.error.bad_value: “{key}” has a value Tabdeck can't use.
style_import.error.empty: The preset has no style options.

export.note.pin: Tabs with a PIN become ordinary sections: a dashboard view can't ask for the code.

editor.hint.sync_group: Decks with the same group name switch together

editor.hint.entity_search: Finds the tab that shows an entity
editor.hint.orientation_layout: Bar at the bottom upright, on the left sideways
editor.hint.overview: Every tab as a live thumbnail
editor.hint.compare: Long-press a tab to show it beside the open one
editor.hint.debug: Conditions, templates and timings under the card
editor.hint.preload: Needs Build tabs only when opened
editor.global.bar_fade: Fade the edges when tabs don't fit
